draft.title: Redox titrations
card: A redox titration adds a solution of known concentration from a burette to a measured volume of another solution. The reaction is a redox reaction, with electrons transferred.

Acidified potassium permanganate, KMnO4, is a strong oxidising agent. It is purple and turns almost colourless when it reacts. The first lasting pale pink shows the end point, so no indicator is needed.
To find a concentration, use the balanced equation. Find moles of the known solution from n = c × V, then use the mole ratio to find moles of the other reactant, then c = n ÷ V.
If amounts of both reactants are given, work out the moles of each and compare them with the mole ratio. The reactant with more than the ratio needs is in excess. The other is the limiting reactant.
draft.remember: Use n = c × V, then the mole ratio from the equation. Compare moles with the ratio to find the excess.

a.q: Why is no indicator needed when titrating iron(II) ions with acidified potassium permanganate?
opts: The permanganate itself changes colour at the end point
The iron(II) ions change colour at the end point
The acid added changes colour at the end point
A redox reaction never needs an end point
a.why: Permanganate is purple and turns almost colourless as it reacts. When the iron(II) ions run out, the first extra drop leaves a lasting pale pink. The end point is still needed, so the last option is wrong.
a.clue: Look at the colour of the solution in the burette.

b.q: 0.020 mol of MnO4- is mixed with 0.080 mol of Fe2+. The equation is MnO4- + 5Fe2+ + 8H+ → Mn2+ + 5Fe3+ + 4H2O. Which reactant is in excess?
opts: Fe2+, with 0.020 mol left over
MnO4-, with 0.060 mol left over
Fe2+, with 0.060 mol left over
MnO4-, with 0.020 mol left over
b.why: 0.020 mol of MnO4- needs 5 × 0.020 = 0.10 mol of Fe2+. Only 0.080 mol is present, so Fe2+ is limiting and MnO4- is in excess. Fe2+ reacts with 0.016 mol of MnO4-, leaving 0.004 mol.
b.clue: Find how much Fe2+ the MnO4- needs using the 1 to 5 ratio.

a.best: The permanganate itself changes colour at the end point

problems.detail: No option is correct. 0.080 mol Fe2+ reacts with 0.080 ÷ 5 = 0.016 mol MnO4-, leaving 0.004 mol MnO4- in excess, as the writer's own why says. The why gives 0.004 mol MnO4- left over, which contradicts every option offered, so a student checking the explanation would be confused.
